d:
Enjoy the evergreen beauty of "Rimjhim Gire Sawan, Sulag Sulag Jaaye Mann" from the 1979 film Manzil, featuring Amitabh Bachchan and Moushumi Chatterjee. Soulfully sung by Kishore Kumar, this timeless romantic melody captures the magic of monsoon, love and togetherness.
